# 第44题

**题型**: 选择题

**难度**: ★★★☆☆

**分值**: 2分

---

## 题目内容

44. What can we learn from the passage?
A. Phytoplankton play a declining role in the marine ecosystem.
B. Dutkiewicz’s model aims to project phytoplankton changes.
C. Phytoplankton have been used to control global climate.
D. Oceans with more phytoplankton may appear greener.

## 选项

A. A. Phytoplankton play a declining role in the marine ecosystem.

B. B. Dutkiewicz’s model aims to project phytoplankton changes.

C. C. Phytoplankton have been used to control global climate.

D. D. Oceans with more phytoplankton may appear greener.

---

## 参考答案

D
